pages.text: $(thing)toNeko$() is a Minecraft mod themed around $(#FF69B4)catgirls$().$(br2)Here, you can:$(li)Become an adorable catgirl$(li)Interact with other catgirls$(li)Explore the world of nekos$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Cuteness is justice!$()

pages.title: How to Become a Neko?
pages.text: First, you'll need a $(item)Neko Potion$().$(br2)Use the $(item)Neko Aggregator$() to craft it, then drink it up — meow! You're now a cute neko!$(br2)As a neko, you can press $(k:toneko.roulette) to open the skill wheel and use various neko abilities.

pages.title: Neko Energy
pages.text: Nekos need $(thing)Neko Energy$() to use their skills.$(br2)You can absorb energy with the $(item)Neko Collector$(), or cuddle with other nekos to gain energy.$(br2)Keep an eye on your energy bar — without energy, you can't even meow~
